text: Your ketone strategy decides how you handle salt, since the salts bring their own sodium while the diet drains it. If you're in a crisis and need the fog to lift fast, there's Strategy A, the "Crisis Mode". You drink BHB (beta-hydroxybutyrate) salts and keep eating a standard low-sugar diet. In trials, ketone esters, salts and MCT oil improved thinking a little against a placebo, from a single dose as well as over two weeks or more (Bonnechère, et al, 2026).
section: Fixing ATP Signaling if Cortisol Isn't High
reader: someone with trauma or in withdrawal who is anxious, wired, numb or foggy, about to choose how to get ketones and wanting to know what each way asks of them and does
